1	export type RateLimiterMode = 'fixed' | 'sliding'
2	
3	export interface RateLimiterOptions {
4	  max: number
5	  windowMs: number
6	  mode: RateLimiterMode
7	  now?: () => number
8	}
9	
10	interface FixedEntry {
11	  windowStart: number
12	  count: number
13	}
14	
15	export class RateLimiter {
16	  private readonly max: number
17	  private readonly windowMs: number
18	  private readonly mode: RateLimiterMode
19	  private readonly now: () => number
20	  private fixedEntries = new Map<string, FixedEntry>()
21	  private slidingEntries = new Map<string, number[]>()
22	
23	  constructor(options: RateLimiterOptions) {
24	    this.max = options.max
25	    this.windowMs = options.windowMs
26	    this.mode = options.mode
27	    this.now = options.now ?? (() => Date.now())
28	  }
29	
30	  allow(key: string): boolean {
31	    return this.mode === 'fixed' ? this.allowFixed(key) : this.allowSliding(key)
32	  }
33	
34	  private allowFixed(key: string): boolean {
35	    const t = this.now()
36	    const windowStart = Math.floor(t / this.windowMs) * this.windowMs
37	    const entry = this.fixedEntries.get(key)
38	    if (!entry || entry.windowStart !== windowStart) {
39	      this.fixedEntries.set(key, { windowStart, count: 1 })
40	      return true
41	    }
42	    if (entry.count >= this.max) return false
43	    entry.count += 1
44	    return true
45	  }
46	
47	  private allowSliding(key: string): boolean {
48	    const t = this.now()
49	    const cutoff = t - this.windowMs
50	    const timestamps = this.slidingEntries.get(key) ?? []
51	    const fresh = timestamps.filter((ts) => ts > cutoff)
52	    if (fresh.length >= this.max) {
53	      this.slidingEntries.set(key, fresh)
54	      return false
55	    }
56	    fresh.push(t)
57	    this.slidingEntries.set(key, fresh)
58	    return true
59	  }
60	}
61

1	import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
2	import { RateLimiter } from '../src/rate-limiter'
3	
4	describe('RateLimiter', () => {
5	  describe('fixed mode', () => {
6	    it('allows the first request for a key', () => {
7	      const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
8	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
9	    })
10	
11	    it('rejects requests beyond max within the same window', () => {
12	      const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 3, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
13	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
14	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
15	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
16	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
17	    })
18	
19	    it('tracks separate counts per key', () => {
20	      const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 1, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
21	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
22	      expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(true)
23	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
24	      expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(false)
25	    })
26	
27	    it('resets capacity when a new window begins', () => {
28	      let now = 0
29	      const limiter = new RateLimiter({
30	        max: 2,
31	        windowMs: 1000,
32	        mode: 'fixed',
33	        now: () => now,
34	      })
35	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
36	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
37	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
38	      now = 1000
39	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
40	    })
41	  })
42	
43	  describe('sliding mode', () => {
44	    it('rejects requests still inside the trailing window even after a fixed boundary would reset', () => {
45	      let now = 999
46	      const limiter = new RateLimiter({
47	        max: 5,
48	        windowMs: 1000,
49	        mode: 'sliding',
50	        now: () => now,
51	      })
52	      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
53	        expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
54	      }
55	      now = 1100
56	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
57	    })
58	
59	    it('allows a request once the oldest call has aged out', () => {
60	      let now = 0
61	      const limiter = new RateLimiter({
62	        max: 5,
63	        windowMs: 1000,
64	        mode: 'sliding',
65	        now: () => now,
66	      })
67	      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
68	        expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
69	      }
70	      now = 500
71	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
72	      now = 1100
73	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
74	    })
75	
76	    it('tracks separate trailing windows per key', () => {
77	      const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 1, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding' })
78	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
79	      expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(true)
80	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
81	      expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(false)
82	    })
83	  })
84	})
